tasks.label: oakctl: prep
args:
cd "${workspaceFolder}" && mkdir -p .build && BOARD_IP_INPUT="${input:boardIP}" && if [ -n "$BOARD_IP_INPUT" ]; then BOARD_IP="$BOARD_IP_INPUT"; else echo "No IP provided; running oakctl list..."; OAK_LIST=$(oakctl list 2>&1); echo "$OAK_LIST"; IPS=$(echo "$OAK_LIST" | grep -Eo "([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}" | sort -u); COUNT=$(echo "$IPS" | grep -c . || true); if [ "$COUNT" = "0" ]; then echo "No OAK devices found via oakctl list and no IP provided." 1>&2; exit 1; fi; if [ "$COUNT" = "1" ]; then BOARD_IP=$(echo "$IPS" | head -n 1); echo "Auto-selected BOARD_IP=$BOARD_IP"; else echo "Multiple devices found. Select IP by number:"; echo "$IPS" | nl -w2 -s": "; printf "#? "; read -r SEL; BOARD_IP=$(echo "$IPS" | sed -n "${SEL}p"); if [ -z "$BOARD_IP" ]; then echo "Invalid selection." 1>&2; exit 1; fi; fi; fi && printf "BOARD_IP=%s
" "$BOARD_IP" > .build/oak.env && printf "set pagination off
target extended-remote %s:5678
remote get /app/build/main "%s/.build/main_device"
set substitute-path /app %s
exec-file "%s/.build/main_device"
" "$BOARD_IP" "${workspaceFolder}" "${workspaceFolder}" "${workspaceFolder}" > .build/oak.gdb && touch .build/main_device && chmod +x .build/main_device && echo "Using BOARD_IP=$BOARD_IP"

tasks.label: oakctl: connect
args: cd "${workspaceFolder}" && source .build/oak.env && echo "Trying oakctl connect without password (will prompt only if needed)..." && if oakctl connect "$BOARD_IP"; then echo "Connected to $BOARD_IP (cached auth or no auth needed)."; else echo "Connect failed; prompting for password..."; printf "OAK password: "; stty -echo; read -r OAK_PASS; stty echo; echo; oakctl -p "$OAK_PASS" connect "$BOARD_IP"; fi

tasks.label: oakctl: select config (run)
args:
cd "${workspaceFolder}" && if [ -f .vscode/oakapp.run.toml ]; then cp -f .vscode/oakapp.run.toml oakapp.toml; echo "Selected .vscode/oakapp.run.toml -> oakapp.toml"; else echo ".vscode/oakapp.run.toml not found; using existing oakapp.toml"; fi && printf "#!/bin/sh
echo "Starting Backend"
/app/build/main
" > backend-run.sh && chmod +x backend-run.sh

tasks.label: oakctl: select config (debug)
args:
cd "${workspaceFolder}" && if [ -f .vscode/oakapp.debug.toml ]; then cp -f .vscode/oakapp.debug.toml oakapp.toml; echo "Selected .vscode/oakapp.debug.toml -> oakapp.toml"; else echo ".vscode/oakapp.debug.toml not found; using existing oakapp.toml"; fi && printf "#!/bin/sh
echo "Starting Backend"
gdbserver 0.0.0.0:5678 /app/build/main
" > backend-run.sh && chmod +x backend-run.sh

tasks.label: oakctl: app debug
args: cd "${workspaceFolder}" && source .build/oak.env && echo "=== Building and deploying app ===" && for i in 1 2; do echo "Debug start attempt $i..."; if oakctl app run . -d "$BOARD_IP" -b; then echo "=== Build complete, waiting for debugger ==="; exit 0; fi; echo "oakctl app run failed on attempt $i, retrying in 2s..."; sleep 2; done; echo "Failed to start app after 2 attempts." 1>&2; exit 1

tasks.label: oakctl: app logs
args: cd "${workspaceFolder}" && source .build/oak.env && until oakctl app logs 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 -d "$BOARD_IP"; do echo "Waiting for app logs..."; sleep 1; done

tasks.label: oakctl: wait
args: cd "${workspaceFolder}" && source .build/oak.env && echo "Waiting for gdbserver on ${BOARD_IP}:5678..." && sleep 2 && for i in $(seq 1 120); do (echo > /dev/tcp/${BOARD_IP}/5678) >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "gdbserver is up." && exit 0; sleep 1; done; echo "Timeout waiting for gdbserver." 1>&2; exit 1

tasks.label: oakctl: app stop
args: cd "${workspaceFolder}" && if [ -f .build/oak.env ]; then source .build/oak.env && oakctl app stop 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 -d "$BOARD_IP"; else echo ".build/oak.env not found, nothing to stop"; fi

inputs.description: Enter OAK board IP address (or leave empty to auto-detect via oakctl list)
